watches.day: Approximately five days before the May 23 opening
watches.summary: Journey and training occupy the preceding five days; their formal session-boundary status remains open.
Long afternoon shadows establish the roadside opening; the patrol approaches within minutes.
One-hour ride reaches Karawa; the subsequent temple conference is explicitly corrected to evening.
Camp preparations and the hawk inquiry occur this evening, after the temple conference.
Many days flicker past; the glass’s destruction falls in late spring or early summer.
A day in town includes the intervening night before the following evening’s ritual.
The following evening brings the temple ritual; shared visions begin after submersion.
Shipboard sunset becomes starry night within a vision, without advancing the adventure calendar.
The mesa vision is explicitly evening; the woman’s plea fades into darkness.
Awaken to the attack; ceremony lasts at most about thirty minutes; return after sunset.
